entry.dc:title: HARDWARE, SOFTWARE, AND SYSTEM CONSIDERATIONS IN COMPUTER-BASED OPEN PIT MINE TRUCK DISPATCHING.
entry.dc:creator: Baker M.R.
entry.dc:description: Modular hardware and software subsystems can be integrated to obtain a functioning, field-supportable computer-based system for optimal dispatching of haulage vehicles in an open pit mine. However, the task is much more complicated than it appears. Here are considered key aspects of the problem using an example the DISPATCH system installed at the Tyrone mine of the Phelps Dodge Corporation.

entry.dc:title: Pulsation Torques of an Induction Slip Ring Motor with a Pulse Controlled Resistance in the Rotor Circuit.
entry.dc:creator: Chura V.
entry.dc:description: The article presents the theory needed for the design of a computer program for an exact computation of pulsation torques. A simple formula is also derived for the approximate determination of the amplitude of the pulsation torque at the slip s equals 1/6 when the pulsation torque attains large values. An example of the calculation of pulsation torques is presented for a 6 kv, 200 kw motor considered for the drive of transport belts in an open pit mine. Although there exists possibilities for an effective limitation of pulsation torques, they increase the costs of the drive as well as the electrical and machine complexity of the drive.

entry.dc:title: NEW BUCKET WHEEL RECLAIMER FOR EUROPE'S BIGGEST ELECTRIC POWER CENTRE.
entry.dc:creator: Dette A.
entry.dc:description: The bucket wheel reclaimer will be operating the coal stockpile situated between the open pit mine and the power station, and as of September 1983 will continuously reclaim the coal from the stockpile at a daily output of 120,000 t. The bucket wheel reclaimer has been designed on the basis that the machine will normally be operating by the side block digging method and will load a conveyor system taking the coal away. However, full block operation will also be possible.

entry.dc:title: Utilization of Burden Rock of Coal Deposits.
entry.dc:creator: Ratynskii V.
entry.dc:description: About 1. 5 billion t of burden rock were dumped in the USSR in 1979. Using the example of the Angrenskiy open pit mine the possibilities of utilizing the burden rock are considered. In particular, utilization of kaolin, clays, limestone and gypsum as well as other minerals is discussed.

entry.dc:title: A feasibility study for controlling groundwater around an open pit mine with slurry trench cutoff.
entry.dc:creator: Haug M.D.
entry.dc:description: The technical feasibility of controlling groundwater around an existing open pit uranium mine in Northern Saskatchewan by means of a slurry trench cutoff around the excavation is evaluated. (from authors' abstract)

entry.dc:title: Genecological investigations on zinc plants. V. Barriers to gene flow limiting the introgression of Viola arvensis (Murr.) into Viola calaminaria Lej. ssp. westfalica (Lej.) Ernst ( Blankenrode, West Germany).
entry.dc:creator: Kakes P.
entry.dc:description: Hybrids of V. arvensis (annual) and V. calaminaria (perennial) are found on an open pit mine near Blankenrode (W. Germany). Morphological as well as karyological studies show that these hybrids represent different generations of selfing and/or backcrossing to V. calaminaria. The hybrids show a low Zn tolerance. F<inf>1</inf> and F<inf>2</inf> hybrids have a higher fitness than V. calaminaria if both are grown in normal soil. This is caused by hybrid vigour and by a combination of the reproductive strategies of the parent species. When the progenies of hybrid plants are cultivated together with V. calaminaria in soil with Zn added to it, no difference in reproductive capacity is shown. -from Author

entry.dc:title: COMPUTERS IN MINING: PROGRESS AND PITFALLS.
entry.dc:creator: Stokes W.
entry.dc:description: This article reviews the progress made in the last twenty years in the application of computers to ore reserve estimation and open pit mine planning. It explains why it is still difficult to find appropriate software for a problem. The answer lies partly in the difficulty of fitting technical computing into a data processing department and partly in the rapid change in hardware. Much of the existing software is too rigid in structure and cannot be easily adapted to particular needs. The general characteristics of a new generation of mining software, already under development should solve a number of current problems according to the author.

entry.dc:title: ERDENET - WORLD'S NEWEST PORPHYRY COPPER-MOLY MINE.
entry.dc:creator: ARGALL G.
entry.dc:description: A NEW OPEN PIT MINE AND 44,000 TON-PER-DAY PORPHYRY COPPER-MOLYBDENUM MILL IS NOW IN OPERATION IN MONGOLIA BY A COOPERATIVE SOVIET-MONGOLIAN PROGRAM. THE PORPHYRY DEPOSIT AVERAGES0. 85 PERCENT COPPER AND 0. 016 PERCENT MOLYBDENUM.

entry.dc:title: Prospects of Development of the Ekibastuz Deposit.
entry.dc:creator: Tomakov P.
entry.dc:description: Based on a multivariant analysis, a succession of steps of transition from multiple coal pits to a single large open pit mine in the Ekibastuz basin is determined. The open pit mine will be 600 in deep and will produce 150 Mt of coal per annum. The transportation coal will be carried out by 9 railroad branch lines, each successively going deeper into the mine and linked to different railroad stations.

entry.dc:title: PINSON MINE: A CARLIN TYPE GOLD DEPOSIT.
entry.dc:creator: Antoniuk T.
entry.dc:description: The Pinson property is located in Humboldt County in Nevada. The open pit mine and 1000 tpd mill were brought into production in January 1981. The article describes mineralization and reserves.

entry.dc:title: NEW DEVELOPMENTS IN CONTINUOUS MINING AND MATERIALS HANDLING.
entry.dc:creator: Rixen W.
entry.dc:description: Bulk mining and handling technologies have been affected in two ways by the soaring cost of oil and oil products in recent years. The substitution of oil by coal, oil sands and oil shale demands the development of high-capacity mining and handling equipment, and the rising fuel costs favor a trend away from cost-intensive heavy truck transport. To cope with the growing volumes of material in mining and handling, larger equipment units have to be designed. This tendency becomes apparent from the examples of the Hambach open pit mine in Germany. A combination of the flexibility of heavy truck transport and the cost advantages of belt conveyors is achieved by the system of semi-mobile crushing installations described in this paper.

entry.dc:title: A study of radiation parameters in an open PIT mine
entry.dc:creator: Leach V.A.
entry.dc:description: Radiation parameters associated with the open pit mining of a small (10,000 tonnes), but high grade (2) uranium deposit at Nabarlek, N.T., have been investigated in detail. External radiation levels, radon emanation rates and radon daughter levels were measured systematically during the development of the mine, and are correlated with ore grade, properties of the host rock and atmospheric conditions. Significant radon daughter concentrations were observed only under stable atmospheric conditions, usually during the night and were invariably associated with thermal inversions. The mean cumulative exposure to radon daughters was estimated from the measured levels to be 0.065 Working Level Months for employees working in the pit for the entire four and a half months of mining. The mean cumulative external gamma ray exposure for the same employee group was measured using thermoluminescent dosimeters to be 2.3 mSv (230 mrem). For most other employees, however, exposures were much lower. Data on long lived radionuclides in dust and on particle size distribution are also presented. © 1982 Health Physics Society Pergamon Press Ltd.

entry.dc:title: On the mechanism and process of slope deformation in an open pit mine
entry.dc:creator: Wang S.
entry.prism:publicationName: Rock Mechanics Felsmechanik Mecanique Des Roches
entry.dc:description: On the Mechanism and Process of Slope Deformation in an Open Pit Mine: This paper presents an example of slide-toppling deformation in the slope of Jinchuan open pit mine. The composite mechanism and deformation process are controlled by the tabular-blocky structure of a faulted rock mass. The rheologic behaviour is found to be consistent with a three stage creep law and can be expressed by an exponential function. The results of field investigations and long-term observations demonstrate that the time-dependent deformation of rock masses is essentially related to creep along faults and other weak surfaces. © 1981 Springer-Verlag.

entry.dc:title: THREE Cu ORE TYPES MINED AT BAIYIN OPEN PIT MINE.
entry.dc:creator: Argall G.
entry.dc:description: 2. 0 percent copper on average is mined from two open pits at this Chinese operation. Shafts are being sunk to access underground mineralization.

entry.dc:title: AUTOMATIC TRUCK DISPATCH COMES OF AGE.
entry.dc:creator: Anon
entry.dc:description: The Automatic Truck Identification and Dispatching (ATID) system increases the productivity of open pit mine assets (trucks, shovels, crushers). The system described is being used at the Mount Wright iron ore mine of Quebec Cartier Mining Company in Labrador.

entry.dc:title: GOLDEN OPPORTUNITIES FOR MODULAR CONSTRUCTION.
entry.dc:creator: Zambon D.
entry.dc:description: This paper describes how using modular construction a chemical plant has been built for the production of crude oil from Canadian oil sands. The construction project included: an open pit mine, hot water extraction plant, and hydration/demineralization and bitumen upgrading facilities. The main objective of the facilities was to mine the tar sands, separating out the bitumen and upgrading it to a marketable, mineral-free, lighter synthetic crude oil at the production rate of 125,000 bbl (20,000 m**3)/d. Some of the project data are given. By using the modular techniques described, the construction schedule has been cut down by at least two months, thus bringing significant savings.

entry.dc:title: Surface and Underground Drainage in an Open Pit Mine of Gaspe Mines, Murdochville, Quebec.
entry.dc:creator: Liard A.
entry.dc:description: Hydrogeologic and hydrology studies were undertaken in order to design a mine drainage system.

entry.dc:title: SUCCESSFUL METHOD OF SAMPLING AND TESTING HIGHLY FRACTURED MATERIAL, USING LARGE DIAMETER CORE.
entry.dc:creator: Lockhart C.W.
entry.dc:description: A rock strength evaluation study was initiated to help establish slope-design criteria for the projected expansion of a large operating open pit mine in Arizona. A major fault intersected the pit wall in the area of the proposed expansion. This paper presents the methodologies and techniques employed to recover, handle and test samples of highly fractured or poorly consolidated materials.

entry.dc:title: Engineering geological mapping for an open pit mine
entry.dc:creator: Bing X.
entry.prism:publicationName: Bulletin of the International Association of Engineering Geology Bulletin De L Association Internationale De Geologie De L Ingenieur
entry.dc:description: L'objectif de la cartographie géotechnique est de présenter les conditions géologiques pour pouvoir résoudre quelques problèmes de construction. La théorie et la méthode de cartographie doivent tenir compte très étroitement du projet et de l'ouvrage. Il existe différentes cartes géotechniques, leur diversité étant due au degré d'expérience du géotechnicien, à la sélection et à la représentation des facteurs géologiques naturels. Une carte géotechnique devrait pouvoir représenter clairement et précisement les conditions naturelles et devrait convenir à la réalisation d'un projet et d'un ouvrage. Le massif rocheux est considéré être un produit complexe de formations et déformations géologiques, sa principale nature étant d'avoir une structure définie. Sous une charge, celle-ci commande principalement sa déformation et sa rupture. Selon l'opinion ci-dessus mentionnée, en cartographie géotechnique une attention particulière est portée aux problèmes de stabilité. Dans cet article, on discute de la cartographie géotechnique de la mine à ciel ouvert de Jin Chuan et de ses applications.

entry.dc:title: DEEPENING CONSIDERED FOR PIPE OPEN PIT.
entry.dc:creator: Pabst M.
entry.dc:description: Inco's Pipe open pit mine, Thompson, Man. began production in 1970. The pit was designed for a maximum depth of 720 ft, a depth which will be reached by 1983. Plans are underway to increase the maximum depth to 800 ft and extend the life of the mine. The ore grade ranges from an average of 0. 5 percent to 1. 0 percent nickel.

entry.dc:title: Investigation of Irsha-Borodino Coal Supplied to Steam Power Plants.
entry.dc:creator: Bruer G.
entry.dc:description: Statistical processing of data on the quality of coal from the Irsha-Borodino open pit mine shows that the qualitative characteristics according to the data given by the supplier and the consumer are close to one another. The average annual ash content of coal amounted to 9. 1-9. 2, while the ash content of commercial samples fluctuated from 6. 5 to 25. 5%.

entry.dc:title: BRAZIL'S VALEP PROJECT - PHOSPHATE SLURRY LINE COMPLETES FIRST YEAR WITH EXCELLENT RECORD.
entry.dc:creator: Fister L.
entry.dc:description: The authors describe the precedent-setting project, which includes an open pit mine, concentrator, 75-mile, 9-inch pipe line with pump station and orifice station, and terminal facilities at the complex. The line was designed on the basis of bench scale tests used in conjunction with computer models.

entry.dc:title: The greening of open pit mine surfaces
entry.dc:creator: Boecker C.

entry.dc:title: Developing and Putting into Service Computerized Systems of Design of Coal Enterprises.
entry.dc:creator: Kuznetsov K.
entry.dc:description: The main organization in the coal industry of the USSR engaged in the development and introduction into experimental operation of a system of computer aided design (CAD) of enterprises is Tsentrogiproshakht (Central State Planning & Design Instute of Coal Mine Construction). The main structural units of the CAD system are plant subsystems identified by their functional characteristics: the type of enterprise (coal mine, open pit mine, coal dressing factory, coal machinery plant, building industry enterprises), the design stage, the element (object) of the projected enterprise. Plant subsystems consist of a functional and a special software part. The coal CAD system consists of 60 plant subsystems that include over 1000 project assignments whose computer-aided solution requires revision and creation of about 630 computer methods and design standards. The software is developed as packets of applied programs.
